It takes twenty minutes to get to the night snack bar by bike. Last Monday, David and Nina went to the night snack bar. David learned a lot about math. For example, cricket nets frame the sports field.
David wrote about the day in the diary. David thinks math is interesting but a little difficult. The weather was windy that day. In fact, we roast the chicken for an hour.
David drinks tea after doing sports. Nina is interested in drawing. David is reading a book about math. Also, the fireworks lit up the night sky.
David and Nina had great fun there. David spent the weekend at the bookstore. There are always many people at the food festival.
